section.title: Important Safety Information
section.p: Read all instructions before using the .

ul.li: Always place the on a flat, stable surface.
Do not operate the kettle without water.
Do not immerse the base unit, cord, or plug in water.
Unplug the kettle when not in use and before cleaning.
Do not let the cord hang over the edge of a table or counter.

section.title: Electrical Safety
section.p: This appliance is designed for use with a power outlet. Ensure your outlet matches before connecting the plug.
section.note: Never use an adapter that is not rated for the wattage of the (2200W).
